title: Singularity AIDR release manifest
description: Download-center contract between the release pipeline (scripts/generate-release-manifest.mjs), the dashboard server (/release-manifest.json) and the dashboard download center. See docs/contracts/release-manifest.md.

version.description: Release version the manifest describes (semantic version).

publishedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the release was published.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 digest of the exact bytes served at url.

signature.description: Optional HTTPS URL of a detached publisher signature for the artifact.

platforms.description: Platforms the artifact installs on, e.g. any, linux-x64, darwin-arm64, win32-x64, chrome, edge, firefox.

httpsUrl.description: Absolute https: URL without embedded credentials. http: and every other scheme are rejected.
